about: What a person using Nourax Workspace must never see: the upstream name, links, logo or blue.
One source of truth for scripts/check-branding.sh (the guard), branding/audit/scan-page.js (the browser
audit) and the l10n sweep. See docs/branding.md.
Regex syntax must work in Python re, PHP PCRE (used with the u modifier) and JavaScript (with the u flag):
a pattern is case-sensitive, or starts with (?i) and has no other inline flag; no \x{...}, no possessive
quantifiers, no named groups, no ~ character. JSON escapes such as \u200c become the literal character.
Name patterns end without a word boundary, so endings like Nextcloudi or Nextcloudjához match too.

name_patterns.note: Persian نکست‌کلود with or without the zero-width non-joiner
Japanese and Korean, not seen yet, kept as a precaution
Uzbek: Next bulutli, Keyingi bulut (a word-for-word 'next cloud')
the upstream company (Nextcloud GmbH, NC GmbH, or GmbH alone in vi)

link_patterns.note: nextcloud.com and every subdomain (apps., docs., help., newsletter., push-notifications.), nextcloud.bsky.social, mailto: addresses there, any host with the name

external_url_name_check: Any URL whose host is not the checked site also fails when it contains a name pattern anywhere.

asset_patterns.note: matched against the path of links to our own site
themes/nourax/core/img/favicon-mask.svg does not match: the path must start here

upstream_files_note: Served icons (favicon, touch and mask icons, manifest icons) must not have the same SHA-256 as these upstream files.

apps_off.office: upstream Office overview page; the owner approved removing it
apps_off.privacy: only upstream mission text and links

format.server: full server version, e.g. 35.0.2.2 (OCP\ServerVersion::getVersion() joined with dots)

sweep_state.note: Written by the sweep after each run; the guard's --server check fails when it is missing or differs from the installed server and apps.

allow_note: Exceptions, each {"area": "pages", "url": regex, "where": regex, "snippet": regex, "why": "..."}; a finding matching every given regex is not reported. Licence text only where a licence requires it.
